# comatose

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:modeComatose`](gmeow-modeComatose.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/modeComatose>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/awareness`](../../slices/awareness.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Coma — a state of profound unarousable unresponsiveness with no purposeful response to stimuli. The deepest pathological low-arousal mode, carrying [`gmeow:levelUnresponsive`](gmeow-levelUnresponsive.md); mapping to clinical consciousness scales (Glasgow Coma Scale, by reference).
